newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: INTERVIEW - Abra Mining to develop gold find.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Abra Mining to develop gold find.

text.p: Abra Mining and Industrial Corp in the Philippines wants to develop a gold deposit on the island of Luzon but fears it may run into problems because of the Busang scandal, the company president said on Thursday.
Jeremias Beloy told Reuters in an interview at a mining conference here the deposit was outside Bucay town in Abra province.
"It is a big gold deposit," he said. "I'm weighing our options because of what happened to Bre-X. It may have repercussions on financing at the moment."

The Busang gold find touted by Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd collapsed 10 days ago after an independent audit found it contained no viable gold deposits and said its test results were falsified on an unprecedented scale.
Analysts said the impact of Busang may make it more difficult for small mining firms like Abra to obtain financing for their projects.
Beloy said the deposit was being evaluated by Abra Mining.
"There is a Malaysian group and an Indonesian group which are interested," he said, adding the gold was in an alluvial deposit.
